statement: Known DMRG/MPS methods provide variational ground-state candidates. This local pilot is reproducing six frozen finite-chain cases; numerical results will be added only after verification.
status: LOCAL proposal; experiments in progress; no accepted discovery
scope: open-j1j2-real-mps-v1; exact Hamiltonians in benchmarks/suite.json; chi<=8; CPU; no global optimality claim
prerequisites: Python 3.13; local venv installed from requirements.lock
